beats.what_happened: kesar rings the four o'clock bell on the fair morning as she has every morning for fifteen years.

state_changes.fact: has rung the bell on a fair day she holds no right to

beats.location: shrine courtyard, in front of the fair queue
beats.what_happened: jorawar has kesar pulled off the bell rope in front of roughly two thousand fair-goers, and girdhari says aloud that the book does not have her.

state_changes.fact: publicly removed from the bell
denied her in public and knew it was false

beats.what_happened: girdhari scrapes kesar's name off the seva board with a coconut knife on jorawar's instruction while the fair queue watches.

state_changes.fact: removed from the seva roll; status 1

beats.what_happened: kesar repeats the name mohari, which she overheard girdhari say to tejmal behind the storeroom, and bhanwari refuses to explain it.

state_changes.fact: holds the name mohari without knowing who she is

beats.what_happened: bhanwari asks jorawar not to restore her daughter's place but to leave the 1968 page in the shrine register unopened; kesar listens from the other side of the wall and neither of them knows she is there.

state_changes.fact: knows her mother traded her for the 1968 page
does not know kesar overheard

beats.what_happened: sitara arrives from Jhilan buying days ahead of the re-cut and hires kesar at forty rupees a day to read the roll to her.

state_changes.fact: paid money for the first time in her life

beats.what_happened: reading the roll aloud, kesar reaches twenty-ninth Chaitra to seventh Vaisakh and finds nine days with no holder's name; the board carries an old cut line, not chalk.

state_changes.fact: knows nine days of the circuit are unnamed
has nine unnamed days on her purchase list

beats.what_happened: girdhari reads the 1967 entry to kesar: nine days held whole by mohari, widow; he tells her mohari was her father's mother and died in the room kesar sleeps in.

state_changes.fact: knows mohari held the nine days and was her grandmother

beats.what_happened: girdhari carries kesar's question to jorawar and is bought with the promise of reading the new roll at the re-cut.

state_changes.fact: sold her question for the roll-reading
knows a woman from Jhilan has been at the shrine

beats.what_happened: jorawar calls kesar to the front of a forty-person committee and says the number nine, and the date range, before she does.

state_changes.fact: publicly outpaced; status back to 1

beats.what_happened: jorawar adjourns rather than open the 1968 page in front of the committee, and announces it will be done at the re-cut instead.

state_changes.fact: has moved the fight from the register to the re-cut

beats.what_happened: bhanwari tells kesar the fair-day value of the nine days — one lakh forty thousand rupees per fair day — and admits she has known the figure for nineteen years.

state_changes.fact: knows the money at stake and that her mother always knew it

beats.location: bhanwari's house, door open to the lane
beats.what_happened: jorawar offers to restore kesar to the board and pay her two hundred a month if bhanwari signs a statement that mohari never held a turn; kesar reads it aloud and finds bhanwari's thumbprint already at the foot of the sheet, dated the fourteenth of Magh nineteen years earlier.

state_changes.fact: knows a second thumbprinted paper exists and does not know what it is
refuses to sign, for the first time in nineteen years

beats.what_happened: kesar tells tejmal the fair-day arithmetic of the nine days and guesses aloud that jorawar promised girdhari the roll-reading; girdhari confirms it by asking how she knew.

state_changes.fact: has a financial reason to reopen the block
exposed to tejmal

beats.what_happened: girdhari reads the 1968 entry aloud: the nine days sold by mohari for a consideration of eleven hundred rupees and merged into bhairon singh's block; rukmani writes it into the day-book.

state_changes.fact: the word 'sold' and the figure are now public; status 3
will learn of it within hours

beats.what_happened: girdhari says mohari's name aloud to tejmal and states that the nine days were hers.

state_changes.fact: first public acknowledgement — scalp 1
has now spent his position

beats.what_happened: jorawar announces the circuit will be re-cut and sealed on the full moon of Vaisakh, twenty-two days away, and that nothing enters it that is not registered.

state_changes.fact: her only evidence is a private register, which is not registrable; status 2

beats.what_happened: girdhari explains that his register is evidence and not the thing itself, and that the words 'the said' in the 1968 entry prove a drafted deed existed.

state_changes.fact: knows a 1968 deed exists somewhere

beats.location: phoolchand's office above the tyre shop, Jhilan
beats.what_happened: phoolchand refuses to open the almirah, tells kesar to return on Thursday, and tells her he drafted every instrument jorawar's house holds as well as the 1968 deed.

state_changes.fact: knows the same pleader drew both sides

beats.what_happened: narmada states that mohari was unlettered and told her for eleven years that the nine days were lent for two seasons, and that she wants an apology said in the Barkheri courtyard.

state_changes.fact: holds narmada's account, which is a claim and not a record
committed to the fight

beats.what_happened: jorawar's driver takes the jeep to Jhilan with a bag; jorawar visits phoolchand, compliments his almirah, asks after his son's posting in Kota and leaves without asking for anything.

state_changes.fact: threatened by courtesy; does not sleep

beats.what_happened: alone and overnight, phoolchand writes out a fair copy of the 1968 deed in his own hand and tells nobody he has done it.

state_changes.fact: has made a second copy that only he knows exists

beats.what_happened: phoolchand opens the almirah and reads the 1968 deed aloud: transfer absolute, not for any term or season, sold for eleven hundred rupees; the reverse of the sheet carries no registration endorsement of any kind.

state_changes.fact: holds the deed and does not yet understand what its blank reverse means; status 4

beats.what_happened: phoolchand tells kesar that a turn of worship is immovable property so an unregistered transfer of it cannot be received in evidence, and that a turn cannot be sold for money at all; he admits he has known the second point since 1974.

state_changes.fact: understands the mechanism for the first time
has confessed fifty-one years of silence to one person

beats.what_happened: tejmal moves that the twenty-ninth of Chaitra be left open, and the committee carries it twelve to nine with four abstentions which rukmani records by name.

state_changes.fact: has defied his brother in public

beats.location: shrine courtyard, bell platform, two hundred present
beats.what_happened: kesar rings the four o'clock bell on the twenty-ninth of Chaitra; tejmal stands beside her and orders jorawar away from the rope; bhanwari stands at the back of the crowd.

state_changes.fact: held the bell against the block in public; status 5

beats.what_happened: tejmal names the morning 'kesar's ninth, the first of mohari's nine days' in front of the committee and rukmani writes it into the day-book in those words.

state_changes.fact: scalp 2 — named in the official day-book

beats.what_happened: rukmani counts the donation box in the open at three thousand one hundred and fifty-one rupees fifty paise — the largest ordinary morning in eleven years — and hands it to kesar.

state_changes.fact: paid, in public, for the first time; status 6
has taken kesar's side by arithmetic

beats.what_happened: bhanwari produces a government form kept in a tin box for nineteen years and states she thumbprinted it on the fourteenth of Magh believing it would give her child a birth entry.

state_changes.fact: has told the truth to her daughter

beats.what_happened: kesar reads the father's column of her own birth entry aloud and it carries tejmal's name.

state_changes.fact: on the record she is not mohari's granddaughter
his nineteen-year-old instrument is now known to two people who are not him

beats.what_happened: bhanwari explains that kesar's claim to mohari's nine days runs only through her father, and that the birth entry removed that door nineteen years ago.

state_changes.fact: understands the trap; status falls to 5

beats.what_happened: sitara gives kesar six days to get the rule into hukum's register or be publicly named as the forger of the shrine ledger entry, and discloses that she paid jorawar four lakh sixty thousand rupees in cash for eleven days with no receipt.

state_changes.fact: exposed; her eleven days are worth nothing either way
under a six-day ultimatum

beats.what_happened: the lawyer sitara retained in Jaipur finishes reading the judgments on Saturday and stops returning her calls rather than be the one to tell her.

state_changes.fact: her money is gone and only she knows it

beats.what_happened: kesar tells girdhari the four lakh sixty thousand figure and that none of it appears in the shrine accounts he reads out every Vaisakh.

state_changes.fact: has a reason of his own now

beats.location: sub-registrar's office, Jhilan, forty in the corridor
beats.what_happened: hukum refuses jorawar's bundle of fifty-one instruments: a turn of worship is immovable property and not one of the fifty-one, including the 1968 deed, has ever been presented for registration.

state_changes.fact: his entire paper base is inadmissible

beats.what_happened: phoolchand presents a four-paragraph declaration stating he drew the 1968 deed, that mohari was unlettered and identified by him, that the deed was never presented for registration, and that a turn of worship cannot be sold for money — which he has known since 1974.

state_changes.fact: has ended his own reputation on the record
has a registrable document

beats.what_happened: hukum enters the declaration at book four, serial two hundred and six, in the name of kesar of Barkheri, granddaughter of mohari, widow, on the identification of narmada and phoolchand, and requires jorawar to sign column nine as a person present.

state_changes.fact: named in a government book; status 7 — scalp 3
signed under her name in front of forty witnesses

beats.what_happened: jorawar offers tejmal sixty-one continuous days across both fair days in exchange for an affidavit that mohari surrendered the nine days orally in Vaisakh 1968.

state_changes.fact: offered the spring

beats.what_happened: tejmal refuses, and jorawar produces kesar's birth entry and states that he himself entered tejmal's name in the father's column nineteen years ago, for forty rupees, to sever kesar's line to mohari; tejmal then agrees to swear the affidavit.

state_changes.fact: learns his name is on the entry; signs under coercion
has confessed the 1968-era instrument to a witness

beats.what_happened: girdhari shows kesar the affidavit he must read at the re-cut, and kesar establishes that it places tejmal in mohari's room in Vaisakh 1968 while the deed she carries is dated the eleventh of January that year.

state_changes.fact: holds the contradiction that breaks the affidavit; status 6

beats.location: shrine courtyard, the fair, two thousand present
beats.what_happened: kesar rings the four o'clock bell on the fair morning and nobody removes her; girdhari reads tejmal's affidavit and tejmal affirms it, and kesar states the date contradiction in front of the fair.

state_changes.fact: affirmed a false affidavit in public

beats.what_happened: phoolchand produces and reads the original 1968 deed and confesses fifty-one years of silence; hukum reads out book four serial two hundred and six, states that none of the fifty-one instruments was ever registered while inherited days need no paper, and sitara demands four lakh sixty thousand rupees back out of the fair collection.

state_changes.fact: his block collapses to what he inherited
her loss is public and recoverable
debt discharged

beats.what_happened: tejmal withdraws the affidavit, states that the birth entry naming him is false and that jorawar entered it for forty rupees to sever kesar's line to mohari; narmada asks the courtyard rather than jorawar for the apology and about four hundred people stand.

state_changes.fact: her nineteen-year shame said aloud by someone else
fifty-seven-year want settled
keeps the mud, loses the spring, tells the truth

beats.what_happened: girdhari reads the new roll — jorawar reduced to eleven inherited days, chhotu given the second bell with his name against it, the box to be counted on the bench — and jorawar reads the nine-day line himself, naming kesar and her mornings; the board is rewritten in chalk with kesar on the first line.

state_changes.fact: nine days held in her own name, publicly, in front of the episode-one crowd; status 9
beaten, aloud, where it happened
named against a duty for the first time
box counted where she can see it
